response.answer: Recent advancements in local Gaussian process methods focus on robustness, adaptive neighborhoods, and theoretical guarantees for handling nonstationary, discontinuous response surfaces in engineering and computer science. Techniques emphasize sparsity-driven robustification and perspective transformation. These methods aim to enhance computational efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
